noEngines.title: Install an AI engine to get started
noEngines.intro: Murage doesn't ship a model of its own: your bots run on an AI CLI installed on this computer, using your existing login. Set up any one of these and your bots come alive.
providerError.label: Model provider
providerError.credits.title: {provider} needs credits
providerError.credits.summary: The provider reported that its available credit balance was exhausted. The model could not complete this request.
providerError.credits.resolution: If you have already added credits, retry once the updated balance is available. You can also choose another configured engine.
providerError.authentication.title: {provider} could not authenticate
providerError.authentication.summary: The provider rejected the credentials used for this request.
providerError.authentication.resolution: Review this engine's sign-in or API-key configuration in Engines & Models, then retry.
providerError.permission.title: {provider} denied access
providerError.permission.summary: The provider refused permission for this request. This does not necessarily mean you are signed out.
providerError.permission.resolution: Check that the account has access to the selected model and service, or choose another configured engine.
providerError.rate-limit.title: {provider} request limit reached
providerError.rate-limit.summary: The provider reported a request limit. This may be a short-term rate limit or an account quota.
providerError.rate-limit.resolution: Check the provider's limit and reset time before retrying, or choose another configured engine.
providerError.unavailable.title: {provider} is temporarily unavailable
providerError.unavailable.summary: The provider returned a service-unavailable response.
providerError.unavailable.resolution: Retry later or choose another configured engine.
providerError.unknown.title: Provider request failed
providerError.unknown.summary: Detailed provider information is unavailable for this saved error.
providerError.unknown.resolution: Review the selected engine's configuration before retrying.
runtimeError.busy.label: Waiting on another thread
runtimeError.busy.working-folder.title: Another thread is using this working folder
runtimeError.busy.computer.title: Another thread is using this computer
runtimeError.busy.browser.title: Another thread is using this browser profile
runtimeError.busy.shared.title: Another thread is using this browser, computer or working folder
runtimeError.busy.summary: Only one thread can use it at a time, so this thread stopped before it started. Nothing needs to change in your settings.
runtimeError.busy.resolution: Wait for the other thread to finish, or stop it, then retry.
runtimeError.busy.resolutionSend: Wait for the other thread to finish, or stop it, then send your message again.
connectedApps.alias.firstHint: Name this account before you sign in, such as work or personal. Connected apps shows this label.
connectedApps.alias.anotherHint: Give this account a unique label, such as work or personal, so it stays separate from your other accounts.
searchSettings.title: Web search
searchSettings.intro: Use your engine's search tools, or choose a separate search provider. Saving these settings does not run a search.
searchSettings.unavailable: Search settings are not available yet. Reopen Settings after the connection is restored.
searchSettings.engineOption: Engine tools — no separate search account
searchSettings.offHelp: Off disables Murage's native search only. Independent engine and MCP search tools may still be available.
searchSettings.engineHelp: Your engine keeps its existing tools. No Tavily or Exa account is required.
searchSettings.externalHelp: Search queries are sent to the selected third-party provider and may incur separate charges. There is no automatic fallback to another provider.
searchSettings.keyPrivacy: Saved keys are never shown here. Key saved does not confirm service access.
searchSettings.charges: Tavily and Exa receive search queries when selected and may charge separately. Adding or removing a key does not change your provider choice.
searchSettings.providerSaveError: Could not save the search provider. Check your connection and try again.
searchSettings.keySavedNotice: {provider} key saved. Search has not been tested.
searchSettings.keySaveError: Could not save the {provider} key. Check your connection and try again.
searchSettings.keyRemoveError: Could not remove the {provider} key. Check your connection and try again.
notificationSettings.title: Notifications
notificationSettings.intro: These settings mute notifications only. Tasks and approval cards stay active. A bot with notifications turned off stays off.
notificationSettings.attentionHelp: Approvals, questions and requests for takeover.
notificationSettings.failuresHelp: A task or routine needs review after a failure.
notificationSettings.previewHelp: Turn off to use a generic Murage title and message. Clicking still opens the right conversation.
notificationSettings.quietHelp: Suppress all notification categories during this window. Muted notifications are not replayed later.
notificationSettings.permissionGranted: Notification permission is granted. Delivery still follows these preferences and your system settings.
notificationSettings.permissionDenied: Notification permission is blocked. Allow Murage in your browser or system notification settings.
notificationSettings.permissionUnavailab: Notification permission controls are unavailable in this environment.
notificationSettings.permissionDefault: Notification permission has not been granted. You can request it when you are ready.
notificationSettings.errorTimes: Quiet hours need different start and end times.
notificationSettings.errorTimeFormat: Enter valid quiet-hour times in HH:MM format.
notificationSettings.errorZone: Choose a valid named time zone, such as Asia/Bangkok or Europe/London.
notificationSettings.errorSave: Could not save notification preferences. Your edits are still here; try saving again.
notificationSettings.errorPermission: The notification permission request could not be completed. Check your browser or system settings.

calls.macOnly: Calls currently need the macOS desktop app
memoryCorrection.title: Proposed correction
memoryCorrection.effect: Approving makes this candidate the current memory. The replaced version stops being used for recall and stays in history.
memoryCorrection.changed: The memory this proposal corrects has changed since it was proposed, so it cannot be approved. Inspect the current memory instead.
memoryCorrection.unavailable: The memory this proposal corrects is no longer available (it was forgotten, archived or removed), so it cannot be approved.
memoryCorrection.pinLegend: The memory being replaced is pinned. Choose what happens to its pin:
memoryCorrection.pinRequired: Choose a pin option to approve this correction.
memoryCorrection.approved: Correction approved. The replaced version is kept in history.
